title: Casey Adams on raising VC from podcast guests, landing big guests, and building a network from nothing
summary: Casey Adams explains how he raised $1.5M pre-seed for Media Kits largely from podcast-guest relationships, and how he built a network from a small Virginia town. He shares how to land high-profile podcast guests, prepare for interviews, build lasting relationships, and why to just get started.

principles.text: Your network is your net worth: fundraising came from relationships built long before you need the money.
principles.quote: your network is your net worth and you know it's a very cliche thing to hear and say but the only reason that I was able and we as care to myself my business partner and our team were able to raise Capital uh was from our pre-existing relationships

principles.text: Raising capital: nail your story, pitch people who give real feedback and want you to win, and stay consistent.
principles.quote: number one really nail down your story of what you're doing right like every product every company you're selling a story right you're selling why you why now and just why in the market

principles.text: Fundraising is a game of consistency; there is never a perfect time, so get after it.
principles.quote: it was a game of pure consistency getting Nose getting rejections but just truthfully powering through

principles.text: Start an interview podcast as a growth hack for networking, learning, and building a personal brand.
principles.quote: starting a podcast specifically an interview show is such a growth hack to building a network

principles.text: Land big guests by starting with people you know, then ask and follow up persistently via social DMs.
principles.quote: never be afraid to not only reach out but follow up to um to go out there and ask right you never you're never going to get anything unless you ask for it in a polite way in a unique way

principles.text: Build relationships through consistent small acts of showing up, responding, and caring over time.
principles.quote: building relationships means showing up to an event that they invite you to building relationships means getting back to someone's text message or picking up their phone call whenever they call you
